image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cluster of yellow composite flowers (likely daisies or similar asteraceae) in a natural setting. The flowers feature bright yellow ray petals and textured yellow-orange central discs. Green foliage and stems are visible in the background and between the blooms. The lighting is bright sunlight, casting sharp shadows.
